name: i-explainer
judge: python3 scripts/judge.py run final.mp4 --tags explainer-2d,editorial-data,illustration,motion-design --name i-explainer (3 trials, refs: kurzgesagt-short, kurzgesagt-climate, cosmos-spacetime-odyssey)

render.cmd: ANIKIT_RENDER_CACHE=0 anikit-video render spec.json -o final.mp4 --sheet contact.png
render.note: engine output re-encoded with x264 crf 20 (the grain makes the engine's file ~260 MB)

audio: -14 LUFS integrated; noise cancelled by summing it with its own inverted copy (residual 0)
